lines.text: Three days after arriving, Festus goes up to Jerusalem, where the chief priests and leaders ask him to summon Paul.
Festus refuses to summon Paul and tells the leaders to come down to Caesarea, where he sits on the judgment seat.
Paul is surrounded by accusers with charges they cannot prove, and he says he has committed no offense against Caesar.
Festus asks Paul to stand trial in Jerusalem, but Paul says he ought to be tried before the council in Jerusalem.

wrong_details.wrong: Paul says he ought to be tried before the council in Jerusalem
wrong_details.true: Paul says he ought to be tried before the judgment seat of Caesar

lines.text: Paul appeals to Caesar, and Festus confers with the high priest and replies, "To Caesar you will go!"

wrong_details.wrong: Festus confers with the high priest
